title: Extracting a counter loop body configuration
statement: Given an index $a$ into a state set and a configuration of a machine with $k+1$ work tapes whose states are counter-loop states, form a configuration of the original $k$-tape machine by setting its state to $a$ and retaining the input-head position, output, and the contents and head positions of the first $k$ work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with $k+1$ work tapes and counter-loop states
